entities.name: David
entities.summary: King of Israel; associated with many Psalms.

entities.name: Anointing of David
entities.summary: Samuel anoints David in Bethlehem while Saul is still king.

entities.name: David and Goliath
entities.summary: David defeats the Philistine champion in the Valley of Elah.

entities.name: David takes Jerusalem
entities.summary: David captures the Jebusite stronghold and makes it his capital.
